release_notes:
## Unified custom icon suite

- Replaced the remaining editor action icons with white transparent resources instead of Geometry Dash icon frames.
- Added custom Edit, Done, Transform, Restore, Rename, Copy, Close, navigation, Apply Layout, and Update Layout icons.
- Apply Layout and Update Layout reuse the exact Layouts folder contour with a clean transparent gap behind the inner symbol.
- Trash cards now use one stable Generic Block icon instead of random sprites captured from Geometry Dash or another mod.
- Added shared custom icon-button components and included the complete suite on Windows, Android32, and Android64.
